system.title: Raibach E-Commerce Catalog
system.versionNote: the version is the /v…/ segment of the catalogId — catalog.json declares no version field of its own
system.description: THE SCHEMA for the e-commerce pipeline. Same job as the prompt-composer catalog: what the server validates an A2UI payload against. One file per pipeline — the pipelines never share a catalogId, so a surface can only render its own components.
system.ownerNote: The catalogue declares no owner field. Nothing in the repository says who owns a catalogue.
system.tokensNote: No token count exists anywhere: the catalogue, the manifest and the ledger carry none per element or per catalogue. The only token-ish numbers in the repository are session totals (tokenEstimate on two ledger records), which are not per-element and must not be shown as if they were.
system.categoryNote: No declared category exists (layout / components / actions are not in any file). The groups below are DERIVED from the allowlist's surface + column — the only grouping the repository actually states. A real layout/component/action category has to be DECLARED per element in the catalogue.
system.figmaLayersNote: Figma layers are not drawn: they need the design file and an API token. The Figma node each element came from is shown instead (registry.json), and the ingest ledger for it.
system.gateNote: no audit has been run for this catalogue (frontend/catalog-audit/ecommerce.json is absent)
system.removalNote: 6 removal record(s) in backend/logs/figma-ingest.jsonl, and not one names a node or a tag. The ledger says a removal happened and what the audit counted afterwards; it does not say what was removed. The counts in those verdicts are the only trace (58 components before 01:10:49Z, 57 after 01:11:58Z).
